    ttop=min(rs); tleft=min(cs); TH=max(rs)-ttop+1; TW=max(cs)-tleft+1
    T=[[g[r][c] for c in range(tleft,tleft+TW)] for r in range(ttop,ttop+TH)]

    Hh=max(r for r,c in obj for obj in objs)-min(r for r,c in objs) if False else None
